sections.title: Direct और Indirect Speech की मूल अवधारणा
sections.content:
Direct Speech में वक्ता के शब्द ज्यों के त्यों लिखे जाते हैं और उन्हें inverted commas में रखा जाता है। Indirect Speech में वही बात बिना inverted commas के अपने शब्दों में लिखी जाती है।

Step 1: Reporting verb (said, says) पहचानें।
Step 2: Inverted commas हटाएं और that लगाएं (यदि आवश्यक हो)।
Step 3: Tense और pronoun में आवश्यक परिवर्तन करें।

sections.title: Assertive Sentences (Statements) का परिवर्तन
sections.content:
Assertive sentence सामान्य कथन होता है।

Rule:
1. said/says के बाद that लगाया जाता है।
2. Comma हटाकर that से जोड़ते हैं।
3. Tense change नियम लागू होता है (यदि reporting verb past में है)।

Example:
Direct: He said, "She is happy."
Step 1: said past में है।
Step 2: is (present) को was (past) में बदलेंगे।
Indirect: He said that she was happy.

sections.title: Say/Says/Said से Tell/Tells/Told का नियम
sections.content:
जब reporting verb के बाद object (me, him, her, us, them) आता है, तो say की जगह tell का प्रयोग होता है।

Rule:
1. said to → told
2. says to → tells
3. say to → tell

Example:
Direct: He said to me, "You are late."
Step 1: said to me → told me
Step 2: are → were (past reporting verb)
Indirect: He told me that I was late.

sections.title: Basic Tense Shift नियम
sections.content:
यदि reporting verb past tense में है, तो tense एक step पीछे चला जाता है।

Present Simple → Past Simple
Present Continuous → Past Continuous
Present Perfect → Past Perfect
Past Simple → Past Perfect

Example:
Direct: She said, "I play cricket."
Step 1: said past में है।
Step 2: play → played
Indirect: She said that she played cricket.

sections.title: Pronoun Change (SON Rule)
sections.content:
Pronoun बदलते समय SON Rule का प्रयोग करें:
S = Subject के अनुसार
O = Object के अनुसार
N = No change (यदि universal truth हो)

Example:
Direct: He said to me, "I am your friend."
Step 1: I → he (Subject के अनुसार)
Step 2: your → my (Object के अनुसार)
Step 3: am → was
Indirect: He told me that he was my friend.

sections.title: Universal Truth में No Change
sections.content:
यदि वाक्य universal truth हो, तो tense नहीं बदलता।

Example:
Direct: The teacher said, "The sun rises in the east."
Step 1: यह universal truth है।
Step 2: tense same रहेगा।
Indirect: The teacher said that the sun rises in the east.

sections.title: सामान्य गलतियाँ
sections.content:
1. said to को told में बदलना भूल जाना।
2. Pronoun गलत बदलना।
3. Universal truth में tense बदल देना।
4. that लगाना भूल जाना।

sections.title: त्वरित सारांश
sections.content:
1. Inverted commas हटाएं।
2. that लगाएं (statement में)।
3. said to → told (यदि object हो)।
4. Tense एक step पीछे करें (यदि reporting verb past हो)।
5. Pronoun SON Rule से बदलें।

tricks.title: Inverted Comma हटाओ ट्रिक
tricks.explanation: Comma हटाकर that जोड़ो, sentence जुड़ जाएगा।
tricks.example: He said, "I am ready." → He said that he was ready.

tricks.title: Said to याद रखने की ट्रिक
tricks.explanation: said to दिखे तो तुरंत told सोचो।
tricks.example: She said to him → She told him.

tricks.title: One Step Back Tense Rule
tricks.explanation: Past reporting verb हो तो tense एक step पीछे।

tricks.title: I बदलने की ट्रिक
tricks.explanation: I हमेशा speaker के अनुसार बदलता है।
tricks.example: He said, "I am happy." → He said that he was happy.

tricks.title: You बदलने की ट्रिक
tricks.explanation: You object के अनुसार बदलता है।
tricks.example: He said to me, "You are smart." → He told me that I was smart.

tricks.title: Universal Truth पहचानो
tricks.explanation: सूरज, धरती, पानी जैसे facts हों तो tense न बदलो।
tricks.example: The teacher said that the earth moves around the sun.

tricks.title: Past को Past Perfect बनाओ
tricks.explanation: यदि sentence past में हो और reporting verb भी past हो तो had + V3 लगाओ।
tricks.example: She said, "I finished." → She said that she had finished.

tricks.title: That न भूलो ट्रिक
tricks.explanation: Statement में that जोड़ना सुरक्षित रहता है।
tricks.example: He said that he was busy.

tricks.title: Object पहले पहचानो
tricks.explanation: me, him, her दिखे तो tell प्रयोग करो।
tricks.example: He told her that she was right.

tricks.title: 3-Step Quick Formula
tricks.explanation: 1. Reporting verb check 2. Pronoun change 3. Tense shift
tricks.example: He said to me, "I like you." → He told me that he liked me.
